response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS total FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), s AS (SELECT link_to_member, total, total * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total) FROM t) AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.total) AS combined_amount, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS average_excess FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
